scope: Source patches and previously completed offline observations only.

patch_order.optional_future_route: 0003 applies only after 0002; it is excluded from the S230 canonical installation scope.
patch_order.relative_paths: Relative to the candidate product source root containing plugins/ and scripts/. Exact baselines are the per-file before_sha256 values, not an arbitrary repository HEAD.
patch_order.ordinary_patch_context: Zero unchanged-context lines remove a private host path from the original diff without changing any source delta; use a zero-context-capable patch application mode.

ordinary_prepare_history.memo_lifetime: One prepare invocation, retaining the original accepted start and 180-second budget.
ordinary_prepare_history.cached_facts: Complete successful immutable graph proofs only; exact key includes canonical root, full expected history, predecessor, bridges and embedding depth.
ordinary_prepare_history.standalone_calls: Each standalone history/successor invocation creates a fresh walk.

current_guard6_parity.description: Reconstruct the existing guarded current plan identity in record validation, preserving original clock/resource and admission checks.

optional_a0_memory.default: Disabled when the optional memory configuration is absent; no current configuration is changed.
optional_a0_memory.namespace: Authenticated user, runtime profile, provider/model/endpoint, explicit embedding dimensions and revision, and native store format.
optional_a0_memory.persisted_scope: Per-lineage memory stores and embedding-cache bytes only; attempt workspace, uploads, routes, grants, authority and clocks remain fresh.
optional_a0_memory.host_only_seal: Full bounded memory/cache byte hashes; host does not unpickle native stores.
optional_a0_memory.new_lineage: Fresh namespace with old bytes preserved; no automatic migration or re-embedding.

ordinary_prepare_controls.scope: Production helper execution over owned SHA fixtures; full-history leaf, source renderer and native registration are explicit stand-ins. No actual managed-home or native/runtime proof.
ordinary_prepare_controls.independent_review: Accepted scoped source-only with zero open high/medium findings.

current_guard6_parity_controls.scope: Actual pure producer logic with explicit offline native/network fixtures. Root independently accepted the minimal source delta.

optional_memory_controls.scope: Real owned filesystem storage checks with explicit foreign-UID, native inspect, network, authenticated-scope and FAISS fixtures.
optional_memory_controls.independent_review: No blocking source defect; original suite and two independent negative controls passed.

limitations: Host cancellation/recovery can bypass the adapter callback; expired, cancelled or partial work can leave changed bytes quarantined. No automatic recovery, adoption, overwrite or replay.
Embedding revision and dimensions are declarations. Persisted IndexFlatIP header dimensions are checked; unchanged remote weights under the same declaration are not proven.
The host does not unpickle. The unchanged native guard still deserializes sealed user-owned pickle in the isolated container; hostile-pickle semantics remain unproven.
Native startup mount compatibility, actual native vector creation/load, cross-job useful recall and runtime deadline fit require separate actual integration and acceptance.
Warm runtime reuse is absent: the adapter still stops after a response, the runtime still creates job-specific containers and authority, and native process/session state is not preserved.
These publication artifacts do not prove the current state of any live installation or authorize replay of a consumed operation.

publication_preparation.checks: Input pins, exact before/after patch reconstruction in memory, and public-payload screening only.
publication_preparation.independent_patch_privacy_screening: PASS: exact three patch hashes; no private paths, hostnames, identities, credentials, personal data, raw logs or handoff payload.
